d8b40a53267c6928484dc110a15cb9522762baa8.description: Join us for compelling, challenging, and honest discussions, guided by our 2026 Festival theme: Samarasā: Awareness. Empathy. Action. The four-day programme will be guided by the theme Samarasā: Awareness. Empathy. Action., which comes from Sanskrit philosophy and emphasises the harmony between Citta (mind), Rasa (heart), and Karsa (action). It invites reflection on how thought, feeling, and action can exist in harmony. We explore the forces that shape us to find a perfect balance of awareness, empathy, and action. From the technological to the spiritual, the personal, and the environmental, we trace the cycles of our existence, not just to understand where we have been, but to guide humanity toward where we must go: a future defined by compassionate response. We are also thrilled to reveal this year’s artwork by Balinese artist Wayan Aris Sarmanta, a young talent whose work originates from his hometown’s Batuan painting style. There are more than over 100 events taking place across Ubud, featuring over 150 of Indonesia's and the region's most exciting authors, actors, journalists, poets, and thinkers. Tickets: https://www.ubudwritersfestival.com/tickets

fe12fce99cffaa563aeb7c429ca50c9753f09964.description: Dear Earthlings, Rituals matter. They set the tone, stir the mood, and give us a very good excuse to get together. And this time, we’re bringing a very special guest. Producer, selector, label boss, obsessive music digger and, above all, a truly exceptional DJ. From his iconic Immer mixes to Fabric, DJ-Kicks and countless dancefloors around the world, Michael has built a career around one simple idea we happen to agree with: Great music. Great people. JULIA TIPSY Grooves, grooves and probably a few more grooves. SoFi Flying the Swiss flag and bringing a little Alpine mischief to the tropics. ff31c59ecabafef61427e5bc23b004a209628eb3.description: THE MIDNIGHT FIRE: NEW YEAR’S EVE DINNER & CELEBRATION AT EMBERS UBUD A Five-Course Mediterranean-Inspired New Year’s Eve Dinner & Celebration Welcome the new year with an unforgettable New Year’s Eve dinner in Ubud at Embers Mediterranean Restaurant. On 31 December 2026, Embers presents The Midnight Fire, a five-course Mediterranean-inspired dinner and New Year’s Eve celebration bringing together bold flavors, fire-led cooking, festive cocktails, live music, and the warmth of gathering around the table. Inspired by the vibrant culinary traditions of the Mediterranean, the evening begins with beautifully crafted courses including tender snapper carpaccio and wild mushroom cappuccino, before building toward indulgent wood-fired selections such as lobster or Wagyu striploin. A thoughtfully created vegetarian menu is also available, ensuring everyone can join the celebration. As dinner unfolds, the atmosphere shifts into the evening’s celebration, with Smooth Acoustic live music from 9:30 PM to 12:30 AM, creating the perfect soundtrack as you count down to 2027 beneath the Ubud night sky. NEW YEAR’S EVE DINNER IN UBUD, BY THE FIRE There is something special about ending the year around a table. At Embers, fire is at the heart of the experience. Our Mediterranean-inspired cuisine celebrates quality ingredients, thoughtful technique, and the natural character that comes from cooking over flame. The Midnight Fire brings this philosophy to the festive season with a five-course dinner created especially for New Year’s Eve. Choose between our Land & Sea or Vegetarian menu, elevate the experience with a wine pairing, and begin the evening with a festive cocktail during our early-evening cocktail service. Then, as the night deepens, let live music carry you toward midnight and into the first moments of 2027. A MEDITERRANEAN NEW YEAR’S EVE IN UBUD Whether you are celebrating with your partner, gathering with friends, or sharing the occasion with family, The Midnight Fire offers a relaxed yet festive way to welcome the new year. Expect generous flavors, thoughtful craftsmanship, fire-kissed dishes, handcrafted drinks, live music, and an atmosphere designed for lingering long after dinner is finished. This is New Year’s Eve in Ubud, the Embers way — warm, flavorful, and made for memorable moments.
